description: GraphHopper provides a routing engine providing routes, travel times, road attributes and isochrones from OpenStreetMap and GTFS inputs. The provider is GraphHopper. Geographical and temporal coverage: The Java library or standalone server works on user-supplied regions and network data. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is Apache-2.0. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. model-jsprit is a distinct vehicle-routing optimisation library; its association with GraphHopper does not document this routing engine.
